name: myosin XVIIIB

function.text: MYO18B is the approved symbol for myosin XVIIIB. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in actin filament binding; cytoskeletal motor activity.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Klippel-Feil anomaly-myopathy-facial dysmorphism syndrome (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: MYO18B encodes myosin XVIIIB. Its functions include actin filament binding and cytoskeletal motor activity.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include Klippel-Feil anomaly-myopathy-facial dysmorphism syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYO18B have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
